title: 第296章 撑吐了
slug: 极寒末世我有空间囤货躺平
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

三天后的夜幕再次降临，山洞里的人们逐渐活跃起来。

刘班长和手底下的厨师已经备好了菜，端着一大盆一大盆的食物到山洞外的露天灶台，开始炒菜做饭。

刘奶奶拿着扫把清理山洞过道里的卫生。

吕燕也像往常一样蹲在山洞外烧水。

极寒虽然过去了，但现在住在山洞，山洞里潮湿阴凉，庇护所每天仍然会定时定量提供热水。

林雪和陈维国顺应山洞里昼伏夜出的生活习惯，重新增添和删减岗位。

庇护所里人数锐减，再加上全部住在山洞里统一管理，需要的管理层更少了，裁减掉的岗位很多。

大多数人的赚工分途径，都从固定职位，转移到了更零散的工作。

例如帮忙干零工，寻找可用食材，拾木柴等。

今日，许多人都到田地间，石缝里，寻找生存的菜苗，或者那些尚未发芽但仍然有效的种子。

这些菜苗和种子也是能换工分的。

周凛尤其鼓励大家自己种菜，一盆菜苗也能换不少工分。

不过这个时期缺水，每人每天的水是定量的，能不能种出菜来，还要看他们自己。

很快，饭就熟了，山洞外四处飘着饭香。

人们热热闹闹地拿着自己的饭盒在室外排队领饭，回到山洞享用。

虽然条件艰苦，但其乐融融。

此时，他们不知道麻烦正在逼近。

田曼琪领着身后的52人，看着远方的那面红旗，踉跄着，机械地挪动着双腿往那边靠过去。

那面红旗，是下洼村庇护所的标志，所有人都知道。

他们的身上已经不背什么包袱了。

这一路，吃光了粮食，喝光了水。

食物和水资源匮乏的同时，也再也没有了前行的累赘。

昨天行进一天，路上又死了10多人。

到了昨天晚上，田曼琪终于带着大伙儿分了仅剩的水资源。

可那点水对他们来说是杯水车薪，现在每个人都面临着脱水的极端危险。

下洼村外，大河的轮廓在昏暗的月光下若隐若现。

田曼琪整个人都激动起来，颤抖着手指着前方，用沙哑的嗓音道：

“快看！河！大河！”

田曼琪说完，拖着麻木的双腿拼命往前奔去，再也不顾身后的群众。

身后的人们也像疯魔了一般，不说一句话，直往大河扑。

土地干裂沙化，一群人的突然加速，激起了地上的尘。

田曼琪是第一个扑到河边的。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Night fell again three days later, and the people in the cave gradually became active.

Squad leader Liu and his chefs had already prepared the dishes. They took large basins of food to the open-air stove outside the cave and started cooking.

Grandma Liu took a broom to clean the cave corridor.

Lu Yan was squatting outside the cave to boil water as usual.

Although the extreme cold has passed, I now live in a cave. The cave is damp and cool, and the shelter still provides regular and rationed hot water every day.

Lin Xue and Chen Weiguo adapted to the living habits of sleeping day and night in the cave, adding and deleting positions again.

The number of people in the shelter has dropped sharply, and since they all live in caves and are managed under one roof, fewer managers are needed, and many positions have been eliminated.

The way most people earn work points has shifted from fixed positions to more sporadic jobs.

For example, help with odd jobs, find available ingredients, collect firewood, etc.

Today, many people go to the fields and cracks in the rocks to look for surviving vegetable seedlings, or seeds that have not yet germinated but are still effective.

These seedlings and seeds can also be exchanged for work points.

Zhou Lin especially encourages everyone to grow their own vegetables. A pot of vegetable seedlings can also earn a lot of work points.

However, there is a shortage of water during this period, and each person has a daily quota of water. Whether they can grow vegetables depends on themselves.

Soon, the rice was cooked, and the aroma of rice was everywhere outside the cave.

People queued up to receive their meals lively outside with their own lunch boxes, and then returned to the cave to enjoy them.

Although the conditions are difficult, it is enjoyable.

At this time, they had no idea that trouble was approaching.

Tian Manqi led the 52 people behind her, looked at the red flag in the distance, staggered, and mechanically moved her legs toward that side.

That red flag is the symbol of the Xiawa Village Sanctuary, and everyone knows it.

They no longer carry any baggage.

Along the way, we ate all the food and drank all the water.

While food and water are scarce, there is no longer any burden to move forward.

Yesterday, during a day's march, more than 10 people died on the road.

Last night, Tian Manqi finally led everyone to share the remaining water resources.

But that little water is a drop in the bucket for them, and now everyone is facing the extreme risk of dehydration.

Outside Xiawa Village, the outline of the river was vaguely visible in the dim moonlight.

Tian Manqi became excited, pointed forward with trembling hands, and said in a hoarse voice:

"Look! River! Big river!"

After Tian Manqi finished speaking, she dragged her numb legs and ran forward desperately, no longer caring about the crowd behind her.

The people behind him were also like crazy people. Without saying a word, they rushed straight to the river.

The land was dry and deserted, and the sudden acceleration of a group of people stirred up dust on the ground.

Tian Manqi was the first to rush to the river.
